description: This file is an internal source file for the PDFsharp library, specifically defining internal build context handling for scenarios where both GDI and WPF are defined. It includes conditional compilation for hybrid build validation and an internal helper class to specify rendering context.

classes.name: TargetContextHelper
classes.description: Internal static class providing the target rendering context when both GDI and WPF are defined in a hybrid build scenario.

methods.name: TargetContext
methods.description: Public static field that indicates the current target context, set to WPF in hybrid build scenarios.
